annotations.title: Sum missing invoices of a week or months

description:
The missing supplier invoices of one ISO week, or of up to 3 calendar months, as one total: how many suppliers still miss an invoice, how many transactions they cover, and the spend they cover, in the currency of the lines and converted to the workspace base currency. It returns no rows.

`week` is an ISO week, `YYYY-Www` (Monday to Sunday), for example `2026-W40`. A week has ended when its Sunday has ended in the workspace time zone. Omit it to read the last week that has ended. A refusal carries `error_code`: `week_invalid` for a week its year does not have (a week 53 in a 52-week year), `week_not_ended` for a week that has not ended yet, `no_workspace` when no workspace is in context, `read_failed` when the read of the week failed.

Pass `from_month` (and `to_month`, both `YYYY-MM`) instead of `week` to sum whole calendar months: `from_month` alone reads one month, both read every month from the first to the last, at most 3 months. A month has ended when its last day has ended in the workspace time zone. With `through_today: true` the last month may be the running one, read up to today with `is_complete: false`. A month that starts after today is refused with `month_not_started`, and a running month without `through_today` with `month_not_ended`. A month read that takes longer than its time budget is refused with `read_timed_out`: the workspace was not read. A `to_month` before `from_month`, or months passed beside `week` is refused with `months_invalid`, and more than 3 months with `months_too_many`. A month read returns `from_month` and `to_month` in place of `week`, and no `pending_count`.

Pass `through_today: true` to read the week that is running: with `week` omitted it reads the current ISO week, and a named week that has started reads from its Monday to today in the workspace time zone. `is_complete` is false for that open window, so the figures cover the days so far and never compare to a full week. A week that starts after today is still refused with `week_not_ended`. Without `through_today`, a week that has not ended is refused.

`supplier_count` counts the suppliers that still miss an invoice, with the gaps and the row rule of the missing-invoices card; over several months a supplier counts once. `transaction_count` counts the transactions of those suppliers that still miss an invoice. `total` is the spend those suppliers cover, converted to `currency` (the workspace base currency). It is `null` when a line has no exchange rate for its date: a partial sum would read as the whole figure. It covers the named suppliers' groups only, so it is not the conversion of a `net` below, which also holds the groups with no named supplier.

`totals_by_currency` is the money of the week still missing an invoice, ONE set per currency in the lines' own currency (the currency the bank lines are in), in major units: `gross`, the `copies` and `own_company` movements it holds, and `net`, the figure to quote. Never add two sets, and never convert one. It is `null` when the figures could not be read. `totals_unreadable_count` counts the lines with no readable amount, which sit in no figure.

`bank_connected` is true when the workspace has a bank feed connected: synced, syncing, or in error. It is false when no bank feed is connected, or every one is disabled or not set up. Only a live bank feed counts: a workspace with imported bank statements only reads false too. Then Well sees no bank spend for the week, so its figures cannot say that nothing is missing: the week could not be checked.

`largest_suppliers` names the 3 suppliers of `supplier_count` with the most spend still missing an invoice, biggest first, a supplier with no figure last: each with its `name`, its `tx_count`, its `base_total_amount` in `currency` (null when a line has no exchange rate) and its `available_routes`, the order to look for its invoices in, as on the rows of `well_list_missing_invoices` (`mail_search` when the caller's own Gmail is connected). `other_supplier_count` counts the suppliers of `supplier_count` it leaves out, and `other_suppliers_total` is their spend in `currency`, summed by Well. `other_suppliers_total` is null when no supplier is left out, when one of them has no figure, or when `candidates_truncated` is true: then quote the count alone. Never compute it from `total`, and never from `totals_by_currency`.

`pending_count` counts the transactions of those suppliers whose candidate invoice already waits for a confirmation. They are in `supplier_count` and `total`, as on the card. `unattributed_group_count` counts the groups of spend with no named supplier, and `unattributed_transaction_count` the transactions those groups hold. They are not in `supplier_count`, `transaction_count` or `total`, and they are in `totals_by_currency`. `candidates_truncated: true` means the scan filled its page, so `supplier_count`, `total` and `pending_count` are floors; `totals_by_currency` is read apart and still covers every line.

This tool reads the user's data and changes none of it.

When the token authorizes one workspace, call this directly — no workspace call is needed first. When it authorizes several, this read will not guess which one you mean: pass `workspace_id` on the call.

conversation_id.description: The conversation id returned by the previous Well result, in its meta under well/conversation_id, in its structuredContent, or in its JSON text block. Pass it back on every call in the same conversation, including a call a card makes, so the chosen workspace and the earlier answers still apply. It decides the conversation on its own: nothing the host states about the session replaces it. Omit it only on the first call of a conversation.

from_month.description: First calendar month to sum, YYYY-MM. Alone it reads that one month. Never with `week`.

through_today.description: Read the running week, or a running last month, up to today. Set it to true for "this week" or for months that end with the current one; false reads like absent. The result has `is_complete: false` while the window runs.

to_month.description: Last calendar month to sum, YYYY-MM, at most 3 months after `from_month` counted inclusive. Needs `from_month`.

week.description: ISO week, YYYY-Www (Monday to Sunday). It must have ended, unless `through_today` is true. Omit it for the last ended week, or for the running week with `through_today`. Never with `from_month`.

workspace_id.description: Target workspace. Omit when the token authorizes one workspace. Required when it authorizes several: this read reports one workspace's own figures and will not choose which.

workspace_scope.description: Restrict this call to the family: the token's primary workspace plus the company workspaces under it that you are a member of. Unrelated authorized workspaces drop out of the read; row reads merge across the family, while a per-workspace figure still reports exactly one workspace.

name: well_sum_missing_invoices

bank_connected.description: True when a bank feed is connected (synced, syncing or in error). False means the week could not be checked.

conversation_id.description: The conversation this result belongs to. Pass it back as the conversation_id argument on every later Well call in the same conversation.

conversation_id_note.description: Present only when the server opened a fresh lane, stating that no choice recorded earlier was read.

conversation_id_source.description: Where the conversation id came from: the host's own request meta, the caller's argument, or a fresh lane the server opened.

currency.description: The workspace base currency (ISO 4217) `total` is converted to. Write `total` with its symbol or code, never the currency of the person's language.

from.description: First day read, YYYY-MM-DD: the Monday of the week, or the first day of `from_month`.

from_month.description: First month read, YYYY-MM. Present on a month read only.

is_complete.description: False when the window ends today and has not ended: the figures cover the days so far.

largest_suppliers.description: The 3 suppliers with the most spend still missing an invoice, biggest first.

available_routes.description: The order to look for the supplier's invoices in; `mail_search` when the caller's Gmail is connected.

base_total_amount.description: The supplier's spend still missing an invoice, in `currency`. Null when a line has no exchange rate.

newly_connected.description: Tools that connected to this workspace since the last result and that no session was told about yet, oldest first. Present only when at least one tool is new. The connected-line rule says when to tell an entry; when it does, one line per entry, in the person's language: "<name> is connected.". Never fold several entries into one sentence. Each entry comes back once, on one result only: never repeat its line later.

other_supplier_count.description: The suppliers of `supplier_count` that `largest_suppliers` leaves out.

other_suppliers_total.description: The spend of the suppliers `largest_suppliers` leaves out, in `currency`, summed by Well. Null when none is left out, one has no figure, or the read was cut.

resolved_workspace.description: The workspace that answered, when the caller named none and the token authorizes several.

to.description: Last day of the window, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive: the Sunday, the last day of `to_month`, or today for a running week or month read through today.

to_month.description: Last month read, YYYY-MM. Present on a month read only.

total.description: The named suppliers' groups only, in the base currency. Null when a line has no exchange rate.

copies.description: The part of `gross` that repeats a payment already counted through another connection of the same account.

currency.description: The one currency every figure of this set is in. Null for lines that carry no currency.

gross.description: Every line in this currency, copies and own-account movements included.

net.description: `gross` minus `copies` minus `own_company`. This is the figure to quote.

own_company.description: The part of `gross` that moved between the workspace's own accounts, so it is not spend.

totals_by_currency.description: The week's money still missing an invoice, one set per currency in the lines' own currency. Null when unreadable.

totals_unreadable_count.description: Lines with no readable amount, in no figure of `totals_by_currency`. Null with it.

transaction_count.description: The transactions of the counted suppliers that still miss an invoice.

unattributed_transaction_count.description: The transactions of the groups with no named supplier, which are not in `transaction_count`.

title: Sum missing invoices of a week or months
